title: National Energy Customer Framework adopted (South Australia)
summary: South Australia applied the National Energy Retail Law and Rules from 1 February 2013.

instruments.title: National Energy Retail Law (South Australia) Act 2011
instruments.provisions: applies the National Energy Retail Law

commenced.what: National Energy Retail Law and Rules commenced in the jurisdiction

direction_rationale: Adopting the National Energy Retail Law replaces state retailer licences with one AER authorisation that is valid in every participating jurisdiction, lowering the cost of entering several markets, and harmonises customer protections.

industries.name: On Selling Electricity and Electricity Market Operation

price_series: Electricity; Gas and other household fuels
notes: Starts the same day as SA retail price deregulation, so the two cannot be separated in SA.

assessment.summary: Adopting the National Energy Retail Law replaced a state retailer licence with one national authorisation and common customer rules. It lowers the cost for a retailer of serving customers in several states.

marks.reason: One national retailer authorisation and common customer protections replace state regimes.
Retailers operating in several states comply with one framework instead of several.
